listing.summary: The project reports playing early levels. Later levels are untested. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA Xbox 360 ISO. The reviewed introduction does not specify the exact title ID, media ID or executable fingerprint; check the project’s requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the released native runtime and launcher to import your own disc. The README says the runtime contains translated game code but no original assets.

warnings: The project reports playing early levels. Later levels are untested.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
